JournalFeed was searched as secondary discovery only. Current indexed material included October features such as the ACEP unscheduled procedural sedation guidelines; primary verification showed those guidelines were first online August 19, 2026, so they were not new in this interval. No JournalFeed item was accepted without primary verification.

ACEP clinical-policy resources and dated official-domain search were checked. No new acute clinical policy first online in the recovery interval was identified; unscheduled procedural sedation guidance was verified as first online August 19, 2026.

AHA/ASA recent guidelines/statements and dated acute stroke/resuscitation searches were checked. No new interval-specific acute stroke or resuscitation guidance meeting the EM Weekly threshold was identified.

ACC guideline and clinical-guidance pages plus dated acute-care search were checked. October guidance was identified, but no newly first-online ED-priority guideline meeting the publication threshold was found.

AAP clinical-practice-guideline pages and dated pediatric emergency search were checked. The stored pediatric UTI guideline was first online September 28; no new interval-specific pediatric emergency guideline was identified.

ACS trauma best-practice resources and dated October search were checked. Current 2026 trauma-center standards are operational rather than a new bedside ED clinical guideline; no new ED-priority guideline was selected.

ENA practice-resource library and dated search were checked. The library includes procedural-sedation and other emergency nursing resources, but no new interval-specific bedside guidance meeting the publication threshold was identified.
SAEM GRACE directory and dated search were checked. GRACE-5 Syncope remains the latest listed guideline from 2025; no new 2026 interval-specific GRACE publication was identified.
AAEM clinical-practice statements and dated October search were checked. No new interval-specific bedside clinical statement meeting the EM Weekly threshold was identified.
ASH guideline pages and dated bleeding/anticoagulation search were checked. No new emergency bleeding or anticoagulation guideline first online in the recovery interval was identified.

CHEST guideline collections and dated acute pulmonary/PE search were checked. Current listed guideline updates are September 2026 or earlier; no new interval-specific acute ED guideline was identified.
SCCM and Surviving Sepsis Campaign pages were checked. The adult and pediatric 2026 sepsis guidelines were released March 23, 2026; no new interval-specific sepsis update was identified.

IDSA current guideline pages and dated acute-infection search were checked. Relevant recent updates found were September publications or earlier; no new interval-specific ED-priority guidance was identified.

ACMT statements and dated October toxicology search were checked. Current October material was educational/conference content or referenced prior position statements; no new acute clinical toxicology statement meeting the publication threshold was identified.

EAST PMG directory and dated trauma search were checked. The queued 2026 BCVI page remains under development. A 2026 hospital-based violence intervention PMG surfaced but predates the 30-day interval and is not a bedside acute management update.
ESO guideline directory and dated acute-stroke search were checked. No new interval-specific acute stroke guideline meeting the publication threshold was identified.
ACOG clinical guidance and dated obstetric-emergency search were checked. No new interval-specific ED-facing obstetric emergency guidance was identified.
ERC guideline pages and dated resuscitation search were checked. Current guideline set remains 2025; no new interval-specific resuscitation guideline was identified.

finalCrossCheck: 2026-10-31 exact search: major emergency medicine randomized trial October 31 2026 emergency department. No new current ED-priority RCT was identified beyond already stored evidence.

2026-10-31 exact search: site:nejm.org October 2026 emergency acute trial stroke shock resuscitation. LATE-MT was identified as October 23 evidence already stored and already included in the October 19-25 weekly issue; no newer qualifying NEJM acute-care trial was identified.

2026-10-31 exact search: site:jamanetwork.com October 2026 emergency acute randomized trial. October 14 septic-shock/perioperative and ICU trials were identified but either already stored or lacked sufficient immediate ED practice effect for selective publication; no new October 31 candidate was selected.
2026-10-31 exact search: site:thelancet.com October 2026 emergency acute care trial. No new interval-specific ED-priority publication meeting the selection threshold was identified.
2026-10-31 exact search: site:bmj.com October 2026 emergency randomized trial acute care. No new interval-specific ED-priority publication meeting the selection threshold was identified.
2026-10-31 ACEP cross-check: no new acute clinical policy first online in the recovery interval; procedural-sedation guidance was verified as first online August 19, 2026.
2026-10-31 AHA/ASA cross-check: no new interval-specific acute stroke or resuscitation guideline or scientific statement meeting the threshold was identified.
2026-10-31 SCCM/sepsis cross-check: current adult and pediatric Surviving Sepsis Campaign guidelines were released March 23, 2026; no new October update was identified.
2026-10-31 IDSA cross-check: recent acute-infection guidance identified by the official search was September or earlier; no new ED-priority October guidance was identified.
2026-10-31 CHEST/PE cross-check: no new interval-specific acute PE/VTE or other ED-priority CHEST guideline was identified.
2026-10-31 hematology/bleeding cross-check: no new ASH emergency bleeding or anticoagulation guidance first online in the interval was identified.
2026-10-31 toxicology cross-check: no new ACMT/AACT acute clinical statement meeting the publication threshold was identified.
2026-10-31 trauma cross-check: EAST BCVI remains under development; no new finalized bedside acute-trauma guideline meeting the threshold was identified.
2026-10-31 pediatric cross-check: no new ED-priority AAP guideline was identified; the pediatric UTI guideline is a September 28 publication already stored.
2026-10-31 obstetric cross-check: no new ED-priority ACOG guideline was identified.

2026-10-31 queued-candidate cross-check: PubMed individually verified PMID 42901741 and PMID 42901744 as October 20 Emergency Medicine Journal free articles, but both records state no abstract is available and both official EMJ full-text routes returned HTTP 403 in this hosted environment; neither was promoted without primary results.

2026-10-31 VECARS-2 cross-check: the primary PubMed abstract remains available and confirms a before-and-after observational ventilation-process study without patient-outcome evidence; it remains held rather than used as filler.

2026-10-31 weekly-issue cross-check: database query found exactly four published, non-sample, non-excluded articles with firstOnlineDate October 19-25—ICare-FASTER, LATE-MT, MILD-MT, and pediatric intubation-associated cardiac arrest—and issue 2026-10-26 already contains exactly those four with no catch-up labels.

excludedCandidates.reason: Individual PubMed record verifies October 20 first-online date, DOI, authors, and free-article status but explicitly has no abstract. The official EMJ full-text link returned HTTP 403 in this hosted run, so primary study design/results remain insufficient for an evidence-grade summary; retained in queue.

Individual PubMed record verifies October 20 first-online date, DOI, authors, and free-article status but explicitly has no abstract. The official EMJ full-text link returned HTTP 403, so primary diagnostic-accuracy results remain unavailable; retained in queue.

VECARS-2 primary abstract was reviewed. Real-time BVM feedback improved insufflated-volume adherence and reduced leak in a before-and-after observational study but did not improve expiratory tidal volume and did not report patient outcomes; retained as held.

ACEP/ENA unscheduled procedural sedation multidisciplinary guideline Part 2 was highlighted in current secondary sources, but primary indexing verifies first online August 19, 2026, outside the current discovery interval; not new evidence.

Official EAST search surfaced a 2026 update published about two months ago. It predates the current 30-day interval and is primarily a violence-intervention program guideline rather than acute bedside ED management; not selected.

October 14 randomized trial of intraoperative dobutamine plus norepinephrine in surgical septic shock was identified in the cross-check. Its intervention is intraoperative and it does not have sufficient immediate ED practice relevance to displace higher-priority acute-care evidence.
